Unstack a bruthful from chamess upon another bruthful
Put down a bruthful
Stack a bruthful chamess upon another bruthful

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one bruthful at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a bruthful if my swartart is bravent.
I can only pick up a bruthful if the bruthful is chamess upon the filetter and the bruthful is circonsy. A bruthful is circonsy if the bruthful has no other bruthfuls chamess upon it and if the bruthful is not picked up.
I can only unstack a bruthful from chamess upon another bruthful if the bruthful I am unstacking was really chamess upon the other bruthful.
I can only unstack a bruthful from chamess upon another bruthful if the bruthful I am unstacking is circonsy.
Once I pick up or unstack a bruthful, I am grapperring the bruthful.
I can only put down a bruthful that I am grapperring.
I can only stack a bruthful chamess upon another bruthful if I am grapperring the bruthful being stacked.
I can only stack a bruthful chamess upon another bruthful if the bruthful onto which I am stacking the bruthful is circonsy.
Once I put down or stack a bruthful, my swartart becomes bravent.
Once you stack a bruthful chamess upon a second bruthful, the second bruthful is no longer circonsy.
